Bestiary.WulfrumRover: A small Wulfrum machine that patrols the surface in search of threats and usable scrap. Some units still carry a functioning battery.
Bestiary.WulfrumGyrator: One of the more advanced Wulfrum machines, it hops and rolls unpredictably to throw off attacks from afar. Gyrators are not very threatening alone and were mostly deployed to defend more important machines.
Bestiary.WulfrumAmplifier: These amplifiers empower fellow Wulfrum machines through a surprisingly advanced tesla field. While the field is harmless to any organic beings that pass through it, Wulfrum machines are designed to receive energy from it, allowing them to run at peak efficiency.
Bestiary.WulfrumDrone: The purpose the Wulfrum machines once fulfilled can most clearly be seen through the drones: to harass the basic troopers of Yharim's forces. They were not threatening enough to be a priority target, though their laser attacks could be quite deadly if allowed to fully power up.
Bestiary.DesertScourgeHead: Once a majestic sea creature, this beast adapted to the desert after its home dried away. It now burrows through sand and launches hardened clumps of sediment at anything it mistakes for prey.
Bestiary.DesertNuisanceHead: Smaller relatives of the Desert Scourge that rise from below the dunes when their elder is threatened. The survivor becomes more aggressive when its partner is slain.
Bestiary.Crabulon: A crab that grew to colossal proportions after feeding on glowing mushrooms for far too long. Its leaps shake the caverns and scatter aggressive spores throughout its territory.
Bestiary.CrabShroom: Small animated mushrooms released by Crabulon’s impacts. They drift toward nearby intruders.
Bestiary.HiveMind: A malignant Corruption hive that burrows beneath its territory before revealing its true form.
Bestiary.HiveTumor: A pulsing cyst whose destruction awakens the Hive Mind.
Bestiary.PerforatorHive: A pulsing Crimson hive that releases parasitic worms as it is wounded.
Bestiary.PerforatorCyst: A living cyst whose destruction awakens the Perforator Hive.
Bestiary.WulfrumHovercraft: A flying Wulfrum unit that prepares swooping attacks against intruders.
Bestiary.SeaFloaty: A peaceful aquatic creature that drifts through eutrophic waters, but rapidly flees when attacked.
Bestiary.SeaMinnow: A small glowing fish from the Sunken Sea. It quickly flees from swimmers and can be used as bait.
Bestiary.Clam: A clam with an almost impenetrable shell. After being provoked repeatedly, it opens and attacks with leaps.
Bestiary.EutrophicRay: A large peaceful ray that becomes aggressive after being attacked, circling the intruder with aquatic charges.
Bestiary.PrismBack: A resilient creature covered in prismatic crystals that slowly drifts through the waters of the Sunken Sea.
Bestiary.GiantClam: A colossal clam hidden in the central chamber. Its shell remains nearly impenetrable until repeatedly provoked.
Bestiary.SeaKing: Amidias, the former king of the sea, was freed from the Giant Clam and now offers guidance to adventurers.
Bestiary.SulphurousSkater: Though their exoskeleton provides minimal protection, their deceptively light weight allows them to run on water. These curious insects are even known to ride acidic bubbles for better vantage points and to escape being devoured by surfacing sea creatures.
Bestiary.AquaticUrchin: Closely related to sea urchins, aquatic urchins have been forced to adapt to acidic water and radioactive waste. Their venomous spikes would normally deter predators, but in this sea a painful meal is still a meal.
Bestiary.Gnasher: Though gnashers are relatively slow, these mutated snapping turtles boast an unnaturally strong shell. Attempting to kill and eat one would injure most creatures greatly due to its terrifying biting power and spiked shell easily capable of impaling flesh.
Bestiary.Sulflounder: A relative to certain hadopelagic creatures living in the depths, the Sulflounders are a branch in their evolution with a fragile exterior. This allowed them not to sink to the bottom of the Abyss, though their flesh is barely enough to withstand the acidic water.
Bestiary.Stormlion: A desert predator charged by violent storms. Its crystalline mandibles retain enough energy to awaken skyborne materials.
Bestiary.BlightSlime: Slimes that have absorbed some of the blighted godly essence. Riddled with impurity, they are now more putrid flesh than gelatin and seem ready to burst. Unlike most slimes, they appear to be collecting mass with a purpose.
Bestiary.AcidEel: Though they are predators themselves, acid eels lay near the bottom of the Sulphur Sea's food chain. Their diet largely consists of mollusks, thanks to their ability to squirm into tight crevices. This paired with their speed and camouflage assist them in avoiding becoming meals for others.
Bestiary.NuclearToad: These toads expand like a pufferfish when creatures are near and burst when in danger. The otherwise terrifying inhabitants of the sea have learned well to avoid these critters due to their particularly explosive nature.
Bestiary.Radiator: A species of once near-extinct sea slugs that have learned to carry crystallized depleted plutonium on their backs to dissuade predators, rather than relying on toxins that most creatures in the Sulphurous Sea are now immune to.
Bestiary.Skyfin: Too weak to hunt in the waters below, skyfins instead use their wing-like fins to take to the sky and generally feast on insects or even small birds that dare wander near the sea.
Bestiary.BoxJellyfish: A translucent predator that drifts through the upper Abyss before lunging at swimmers.
Bestiary.CannonballJellyfish: A heavy abyssal jellyfish that becomes dangerously aggressive after being disturbed.
Bestiary.MorayEel: A territorial eel that hides quietly until prey comes close.
Bestiary.ToxicMinnow: A poisonous abyssal fish that releases a toxic cloud when slain.
Bestiary.Toxicatfish: Though these fish once threatened none other than their prey, the radiation from nuclear waste generated from Draedon's old experiments has rotted both their bodies and minds. Attacking anything that comes near, this once flourishing species is now on the verge of extinction.
Bestiary.Trasher: Despite being equipped with a mouth large enough to swallow a child whole, these crocodiles simply act as scavengers, devouring scraps and bones left over from predators' meals. Needing to conserve energy due to eating relatively little, they rarely move at their full speed unless they feel threatened.
Bestiary.BabyCannonballJellyfish: A young cannonball jellyfish that drifts through the upper Abyss and violently bursts when killed.
Bestiary.SlabCrab: A rock-hard crab that hides motionless until nearby movement or an attack forces it to spring into action.
Bestiary.Cuttlefish: A camouflaged ambush predator that reveals itself and relentlessly pursues prey once disturbed.
Bestiary.Laserfish: A cybernetic abyssal fish that becomes hostile when approached and fires focused beams at its target.
Bestiary.LuminousCorvina: A luminous abyssal fish whose warning cry makes nearby predators far more alert to intruders.
Bestiary.Viperfish: A fast, aggressive abyssal fish with a huge mouth used to intimidate predators and seize prey.
Bestiary.OarfishHead: A gigantic deep-sea oarfish. On mobile its long body is simulated by one real NPC and a virtual segment chain.
